title: Alleluia, Sing to Jesus!
description: Alleluia, Sing to Jesus! in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by William Chatterton Dix, first published in 1867. The tune, HYFRYDOL, is by Rowland H. Prichard (1830). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Al-le-lu_-ia! sing to Je_-sus! His the scep-ter, His_ the throne. Al-le-lu_-ia! His the tri_-umph, His the vic-to-ry_ a-lone. Hark! the songs_ of peace-ful Zi_-on thun-der like_ a might_-y flood. Je_-sus out_ of ev_-ery na___-tion has re-deemed_ us by His blood.

lines: His the scepter, His the throne.
Hark! the songs of peaceful Zion
has redeemed us by His blood.
are we left in sorrow now;
Though the cloud from sight received Him
when the forty days were o'er
Shall our hearts forget His promise,
Thou on earth our food, our stay;
flee to Thee from day to day:
Where the songs of all the sinless
Thee the Lord of lords we own;
Thou within the veil hast entered, robed in flesh our great
High Priest; Thou on earth both priest and victim in the
